pendingFeedback.text:
Critic findings from architect review (docs/product/critic-reports/2026-07-31-architect-p1.md) to apply during implementation:

1. [APPLY] Serialize iptc_writer.write_iptc() calls per-file (or globally) with a lock independent of the DB RLock — two rapid assign/unassign actions on the same multi-face photo can otherwise race two exiftool subprocesses against the same JPEG (lost update or temp-file collision). Also use a unique/random temp filename per write.

2. [APPLY] Run the one-time uploads_backup/ copy (~47MB/435 files) through the existing async job_runner pattern (see src/blueprints/photos.py's app_job_runner.submit usage for crawl/upload/OCR) — NOT synchronously inline inside the first assign/deassign request. Either trigger it at local-agent startup, or as a background job the first assign call waits on.

See the critic report for full rationale and the 3 deferred (backlog) findings.

backlog.text: Extend GET /health's ocr_ok self-test pattern with an analogous iptc_ok flag (exiftool -ver check at startup) so a missing exiftool install is visible immediately instead of manifesting as silently-skipped IPTC writes.

If silent server-side-only IPTC write failure logging proves too invisible in practice, surface a soft warning in the assign/deassign response so the user can tell whether the embed actually happened.

Critic (architect p1): guard the in-memory "backup already done" flag with the same lock used for iptc write serialization, so two near-simultaneous first-writes under Flask's threaded=True don't both trigger a redundant uploads_backup/ copy.

Critic (architect p1): remove the now-vestigial write_metadata param construction from web/src/api/photoTaggerClient.ts's assign call once the server-side flag is removed — dead code cleanup, not a functional break.

Critic (architect p1): the GET /api/photos/<id>/metadata "people" array's per-face shape ({id, name, cluster_id, assigned}) is specified in the design spec but not co-located with the endpoint contract in 04-architecture.md §6 — cross-reference spec §2.1 directly when implementing photo_metadata.py and the two consuming components to avoid a shape mismatch.
